_comment: Template for --inputs when assembling a Fedora image. Paths may be relative and are resolved against this file's directory. SENSOR_STACK_SHA256 is a digest, not a path. POWER_SETTINGS_BINARY may be omitted: the assembly then installs no power panel, and the result is a working tablet whose Power panel lacks the project's button-policy controls. See docs/FEDORA.zh-CN.md.
_firmware: FIRMWARE_POOL is the raw vendor pool the first-boot initramfs reads; FIRMWARE_TREE is the prepared tree build-liuqin-firmware-prep.sh emits. The root assembler installs the /usr/lib/firmware closure from the latter.
